context_requirements: Cholinergic neuronal phenotype with functional synaptic vesicle release machinery
Expression of choline acetyltransferase and vesicular acetylcholine transporter
MAO-A/MAO-B expression is not sufficient; the transcriptional program of these immortalized lines is not driven by acetylcholine release
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of immediate-early genes such as FOS, JUN, EGR1 at 6 h across multiple lines
Consistent upregulation of cholinergic or synaptic genes in the landmark set
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes shared across the nine lines at 6 h or 24 h
